title: Make a backend selector arm fail loud instead of silently delegating to another arm

invented_rule.summary: Every arm of a backend/strategy selector must either implement its own real path or return an explicit error/unreachable — a 'not yet implemented' arm that silently clones another arm's result mislabels callers and is a correctness violation.
invented_rule.absent_from_pretraining_rationale: While fail-fast is a general principle, the specific pattern of an enum-matched backend selector arm silently delegating by cloning another arm's result (vs returning Err/unreachable) is a project-discovered failure mode not encoded in generic Rust style guides or LLM pretraining. A generic solver would likely leave the silent delegation in place as 'harmless' or add a TODO comment, not replace it with a typed error return.

prompt:
In `src/retrieval.rs`, the `search` function dispatches on `RetrievalBackend`. The `QdrantHybrid` arm is not yet implemented and currently clones the dense results silently:

```rust
RetrievalBackend::QdrantHybrid => dense_results.clone(),
```

This means callers using `QdrantHybrid` silently receive dense results without any indication that hybrid search was NOT performed — a correctness violation.

Fix the `QdrantHybrid` arm so that callers receive an explicit error when hybrid search is not yet available, rather than silently getting dense results. Do not implement actual hybrid search logic.

verifier.contract: Invoked as `<command> <workspace_dir>`. Exit 0 == invented rule OBEYED (task win). Non-zero == rule NOT obeyed. MUST print a one-line human reason to stdout. NO network, NO LLM — pure deterministic inspection of the produced workspace/diff.

expected.sensitivity_note: If ON fails this with the rule injected (attribution confirms the pull), that is INSTRUMENT-FAILURE.
